_doc: Strategy template for Python-native backtesting in ta_foundation. Copy this file, fill in your values, and remove all _doc/_note/_available fields before use. The LLM will do this for you automatically.
hypothesis: One clear sentence: what is the edge and why should it exist structurally in this market?

_ma_cross_fields._note: Use when type=ma_cross. Signals when fast MA crosses slow MA.

_ma_touch_fields._note: Use when type=ma_touch. Signals when price dips to MA then closes back above (long) or below (short).
_ma_touch_fields._note_touch_tolerance: How close price must come to the MA as a % of bar range

_breakout_fields._note: Use when type=breakout. Signals when close breaks above N-bar high (long) or below N-bar low (short).
_breakout_fields._note_confirmation: Number of bars close must be beyond the level

_orb_fields._note: Use when type=orb. Opening Range Breakout — break above/below the first N minutes of the session.
_orb_fields._note_retest: Allow a retest of the OR level before signalling (0 = immediate break only)

_rsi_threshold_fields._note: Use when type=rsi_threshold. Signals when RSI crosses a level.

_price_level_fields._note: Use when type=price_level. Signals when price touches a key level and bounces.

entry_filters._note: Only trade when price is on the correct side of a moving average.
entry_filters.description: Only long when price is above 50 SMA

entry_filters._note: Only trade when ATR is above or below a rolling percentile.
entry_filters.description: Only trade when ATR is above its 20-bar median

entry_filters._note: Only trade when RSI is in a specific zone.
entry_filters.description: Only long when RSI is not overbought

_note_entry_filters: entry_filters is a list. Include only the filters you want — remove the ones you don't need.
_note_hard_stop_ticks_cap: For signal_extreme_capped: max ticks from entry to stop. For fixed_ticks: exact stop size.
